title: Home widgets scroll instead of clipping, Upcoming Events grouped by day
summary: Every Home widget's body now scrolls internally when its content outgrows the widget's size, instead of silently getting cut off at the bottom -- matters most for Upcoming Events now that it can show up to 50 (or unlimited) items.

Upcoming Events now groups its list under a bold day heading ("Today", "Wednesday, Aug 5", etc.) instead of repeating the date on every single item, so it's obvious at a glance where one day's events end and the next day's begin. Timed events now show their actual time instead of just the date; all-day events show "All day".
